Minimum delivery order $10 Pizza Peddler is located at the corner of Route 926 & Route 202 in the Westtown Village Shopping Center in West Chester, PA. Our Pizza is made fresh daily from the finest ingredients. The unique and delicious homemade sauce compliments our fresh dough, topped with the tastiest Wisconsin cheese. Along with your favorite.
storyMore: Pizza Peddler is BYOB and serves pizza, strombolis, low carbohydrate meals, pasta, hoagies, grinders, salads, burgers, sandwiches, steak sandwiches, breakfast, desserts and more. We deliver to Thorton, West Chester, Concordville, Westtown, Birmingham, Chaddsford, West Goshen, Glen Mills and other surrounding areas.
